name: Löwen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Lions in Tirol**

Discover the wild side of **Tirol**! The **Tiroler Wildpark Ernsthofen** near **Innsbruck** is home to majestic lions, where you can observe these powerful predators up close in a natural setting. The park also features a variety of other animals, making it a perfect destination for families and animal lovers.

Experience the thrill of a **Safari-Tour** through the savannah-like landscapes of **Tirol**, where you can learn fascinating facts about the lions and their habitat. Don’t miss the chance to see these magnificent creatures in action!

**Tirol** offers more than just stunning mountain landscapes—it’s also a place where you can encounter the raw beauty of the animal kingdom. Plan your visit today and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!
